name: Thinking Panel
title: Thinking Panel
description: An AI activity panel with a live timer, expandable source chips and spring-driven progress steps.
summary: Present application-supplied activity with a compact thinking indicator, elapsed time, linked sources and a connected step timeline. Source expansion and panel collapse share a damped spring. Stream steps as work progresses, then show a completed or interrupted state. The studio replays a clearly labelled seven-second offsite-planning example inspired by the supplied video.
highlights: Live elapsed time or application-controlled timing
Spring-driven expansion and coordinated step entrances
Expandable, wrapping source chips with safe external links
Streaming steps, completion and explicit interruption states
Keyboard disclosure controls and live activity announcements
Responsive light/dark themes and live reduced-motion support
Scoped GSAP cleanup with offscreen and background activity pausing
anatomy: Disclosure header with nine-pixel activity indicator and timer

physics.description: A shared damped spring coordinates measured disclosure height, chevron rotation and step movement. Content enters through transform and opacity tweens; ResizeObserver retargets the panel when sources wrap. All observers, tickers and timelines are cleaned up.

accessibility.aria: Labelled activity region, native disclosure buttons with expanded state, inert collapsed content, semantic ordered steps, safe named external links, polite step announcements and explicit error alerts. Timer updates are excluded from live announcements.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Disclosure and steps settle immediately; activity pixels stay static. Preferences can change while mounted.

keyboard.description: Move through the header, source links and source disclosure.
Toggle the panel or source disclosure.
Hide extra sources and return focus to their trigger; otherwise collapse the panel and focus its header.

recommended: Display search or agent activity alongside an AI response.
Append meaningful activity summaries as your application progresses.
bestPractices: Supply real sources and steps; the primitive does not perform searches or invent activity.
Use stable unique source and step IDs, and plain-language step labels.
Pass status=complete or status=error when work stops; supply a safe error message.
Remount with a request key to reset the internal timer between independent tasks.
Provide elapsedSeconds for server-authoritative timing and retain expanded state with expanded/onExpandedChange when needed.

props.name: sources
props.description: Stable id, label, optional HTTP(S) href and optional ReactNode icon for each real source.

props.name: steps
props.description: Stable id and label for each activity step. Append as work progresses.

props.name: status
props.description: Activity lifecycle. Stops the internal timer when work finishes or fails.

props.name: elapsedSeconds
props.description: Optional application-controlled elapsed time; otherwise uses the live internal timer.

props.name: visibleSources
props.description: Number of source chips visible before the more button, bounded to 1–50.

props.name: width
props.description: Preferred width in pixels, bounded to 240–960 and constrained by the container.

props.name: speed
props.description: Motion speed multiplier, bounded to 0.5–2. Does not change real elapsed time.
